current_evidence: The council's 'Information on the Planning Process' page (Last Updated 17/07/2026) links this exact .docx as the 'new local validation checklist' and 'New validation checklist'. A sibling file '..._Jan 2024_final_1.docx' turns up in search but is not linked from the page. Neither the page nor planning.data.gov.uk (start-date 2024-01-01) gives an adoption date in text; 'Jan 2024' comes from the filename only.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the list has a householder checklist (Checklist 1) with local items. Grokbot's own excerpts from the Jan 2024 docx contain these householder triggers but file them under Full planning: Arboricultural Impact Statement (trees within 15m of development), Parking Layout (garage conversion to habitable room, or hard surfacing in a conservation area), Noise Impact Assessment (air-conditioning units and some micro-generation), Sunlight/Daylight (building over 2.5m high within 2m of a boundary), Structural Survey (external retaining walls) and Heritage Statement (buildings of character, locally listed buildings, conservation area).
issues.evidence: May 2022 draft 'Checklist 1: Householder Development' lists Heritage Statement, Arboricultural Impact Statement, Parking Layout, Noise Impact Assessment, Sunlight and Daylight, Structural Survey

issues.detail: Reserved matters is '(none)' and Outline has only a masterplan row and a CMP row. Checklists 2 (residential) and 3 (non-residential) apply to full, outline and reserved matters applications, so the whole set (affordable housing, air quality, ecology, FRA, transport and so on) is missing for Outline and Reserved matters.
issues.evidence: Draft: 'Checklist 2: Residential Development (full, outline, reserved matters...)'; 'Checklist 3: Non-Residential Development (full, outline, reserved matters...)'

issues.detail: Several Checklist 2/3 local requirements are not captured under any application type: Construction Management Plan for full applications (major development, over 10 dwellings, near sensitive uses or restricted access); Foul Sewerage Details (non-mains disposal); Green Belt Statement (inappropriate development claiming very special circumstances); Housing Mix Statement (major residential departing from SHMA/policy); Marketing Information (loss of employment or community facilities, about 6 months' marketing); Odour Impact Assessment; Public Open Space calculation (on/off-site POS); Topographical Survey (major sites; minor sites with level changes); Noise/Vibration Impact Assessment for sensitive development near roads, rail or noise sources. These are taken from the May 2022 draft, because the Jan 2024 docx could not be read; Grokbot's Fire Statement excerpt does include the POS calculation text.
issues.evidence: Draft headings: 'Construction Management Plan', 'Foul Sewerage Details', 'Green Belt Statement', 'Housing Mix Statement', 'Marketing Information', 'Odour Impact Assessment', 'Topographical Survey'

issues.detail: Lawful development cert is '(none)', but Checklist 6 requires existing and proposed elevation and floor plans (unless disproportionate) plus supporting evidence (photographs; for existing uses, affidavits and utility or tenancy records). Advertisement consent is missing 'Elevation plans of existing and proposed buildings with advertisements in situ' (all applications) and 'Visibility splay details' (signs near a junction).
issues.evidence: Draft 'Checklist 6: Lawful Development Certificates' and 'Checklist 4: Advertisements'

issues.detail: The 'Schedule of works (listed building)' row (Full planning) carries the arboricultural trigger ('...Arboricultural Method Statements All developments involving building, demolition or engineering works where there are trees ... stem of more than 75mm'). The requirement name is wrong and no LBC schedule-of-works requirement exists in this text. Likewise, the LBC 'Heritage Statement' trigger is the householder conservation-area text, and the LBC 'Photographs' trigger is the advertisement text ('Optional but advised for proposals where substantial advertisements are proposed').
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt for 'Schedule of works (listed building)', LBC 'Heritage Statement', LBC 'Photographs / Photomontages'

issues.detail: Most Full planning triggers are mid-sentence fragments that lose the threshold or condition. Transport Assessment: 'transport movement, a Transport Statement must be provided.' (drops the TA thresholds, e.g. over 200 dwellings). Travel Plan: 'of traffic a Travel Plan may be required.' Planning Obligations: 'then draft heads of terms...' (drops 10+ houses). Ecological Survey: 'may affect protected species such as bats...'. Sunlight to gardens: 'property and garden areas.' Highways: 'highway, access visibility splays, landscaping...'. Landscape: cut off at 'Will be required for: 1.' Affordable Housing starts 'All applications'. Daylight starts 'source concerned'. Contaminated Land and Archaeology give content guidance ('shall be prepared by a suitably qualified party'; 'must include a) Description...') rather than when they are required. Fire Statement runs into 'A detailed calculation showing provision ... POS must be i'. Planning Statement uses the LBC 'Heritage Statement / Planning Statement All applications' text instead of 'all major developments and any development not in accordance with adopted policy'.

About 30 Full planning rows are flagged 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. In fact the list is organised by checklist: householder items (e.g. Parking Layout, Structural Survey for retaining walls, air-conditioning noise) were placed under Full, and Checklist 2/3 items were not repeated for Outline or Reserved matters. Also: 'Viability Assessment' is placed under Listed building consent, but it belongs to Checklists 2/3, not Checklist 5. 'Flood Risk Assessment' and 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' only because their text mentions 'change of use' (planning applications).
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: Outline 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' is listed as a requirement, but its own text says it is not required ('Outline applications will not normally require a Construction Management Plan, which can be required by condition'). The tab item 'However printable PDF application forms can also be downloaded here.' is process text. The other four tab items are generic national drawing-scale conventions.

Grokbot mixes the superseded 'Draft, May 2022' validation document (site-old/draft_validations_document.pdf) with the current Jan 2024 list. All 5 tab_items, plus the Fire Statement, Floor plans, Lighting, Statement of Community Involvement, Street scene and prior-approval FRA rows, come from the draft. Their triggers may not match the adopted 2024 text.
issues.evidence: Draft PDF cover: 'Validation of Planning Applications: Guide to National and Local Requirements' - Draft, May 2022

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' (Full) and 'Street scene elevations' share the same Street Scene trigger. 'Parking provision' and 'Noise Impact Assessment' overlap in one merged excerpt. Advert 'Photographs' and LBC 'Photographs' share one garbled excerpt.

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's currently linked Jan 2024 checklist. The extraction is poor: it misreads the checklist-by-application-type structure, so it records 'none' for Householder, Reserved matters and LDC, files householder items under Full planning, gives many cut-off or mismatched triggers and mixes in the superseded May 2022 draft. The Jan 2024 .docx could not be read as text (binary), so contents were compared against the May 2022 draft (same six-checklist structure) and Grokbot's own excerpts.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The List date 2024-01-01 is inferred from the filename ('Date basis: url'), not from document text. The council page gives no adoption date, and the docx could not be read to confirm one.

withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The cover says January 2024, which matches the recorded date.
